name: ld_sources
title: Lindblom-Detweiler equations as typed in four sources (with corrections)
description: Transcribed as typed in the source; not derived here.

ZL/H1'.label: ZL: equation for H1'
ZL/H1'.text: r*Derivative(H1(r), r) - (-16*pi*G*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*calV(r) + H0(r) + K(r))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + (4*pi*G*r**2*(-(-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) - 2*epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + l + (1 - exp(-2*lambda0(r)))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + 1)*H1(r)

ZL/K'.label: ZL: equation for K'
ZL/K'.text: 8*pi*G*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*W(r)*exp(lambda0(r)) + r*Derivative(K(r), r) - ((l - 1)*(l + 2)/2 + 1)*H1(r) - (-l + (4*pi*G*r**2*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 1/2 - exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2)*exp(2*lambda0(r)) - 1)*K(r) - H0(r)

ZL/X'.label: ZL: equation for X'
ZL/X'.text: l*X(r) + r*Derivative(X(r), r) - ((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*((-(4*pi*G*r**2*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 1/2 - exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2)*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + 1)*H0(r) + (3*(4*pi*G*r**2*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 1/2 - exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2)*exp(2*lambda0(r)) - 1)*K(r) + (omega**2*r**2*exp(-2*Phi0(r)) + (l - 1)*(l + 2)/2 + 1)*H1(r) + (-8*pi*G*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*exp(lambda0(r)) + 2*omega**2*exp(-2*Phi0(r) + lambda0(r)) + r**2*(-2*exp(-lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)*Derivative(lambda0(r), r)/r**2 + 2*exp(-lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), (r, 2))/r**2 - 4*exp(-lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)/r**3))*W(r) - (2*(l - 1)*(l + 2) + 4)*(4*pi*G*r**2*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 1/2 - exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2)*calV(r)*exp(2*lambda0(r))/r**2)*exp(Phi0(r))/2

ZL/H0.label: ZL: equation for H0
ZL/H0.text: -8*pi*G*r**2*X(r)*exp(-Phi0(r)) + (-omega**2*r**2*exp(-2*Phi0(r) - 2*lambda0(r)) + ((l - 1)*(l + 2)/2 + 1)*(4*pi*G*r**2*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 1/2 - exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2))*H1(r) - (-omega**2*r**2*exp(-2*Phi0(r)) + (l - 1)*(l + 2)/2 - ((4*pi*G*r**2*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 1/2 - exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2)*exp(2*lambda0(r)) - 1)*(4*pi*G*r**2*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 1/2 - exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2))*K(r) + (4*pi*G*r**2*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + (l - 1)*(l + 2)/2 + 3/2 - 3*exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2)*H0(r)

ZL/V.label: ZL: equation for V
ZL/V.text: calV(r) - (-H0(r)*exp(Phi0(r))/2 + X(r)/((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) - (4*pi*G*r**2*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 1/2 - exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2)*W(r)*exp(Phi0(r) + lambda0(r))/r**2)*exp(Phi0(r))/omega**2

BU/H1'.label: BU: equation for H1'
BU/H1'.ref: Burgio et al., arXiv:1106.2736 appendix A
BU/H1'.text: Derivative(H1(r), r) - (-16*pi*G*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*calV(r) + H0(r) + K(r))*exp(2*lambda0(r))/r - (-4*pi*G*r**2*(-(-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) - 2*epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) - l - (1 - exp(-2*lambda0(r)))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) - 1)/r

BU/K'.label: BU: equation for K'
BU/K'.ref: Burgio et al., arXiv:1106.2736 appendix A
BU/K'.text: 8*pi*G*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*W(r)*exp(lambda0(r))/r - l*(l + 1)*H1(r)/(2*r) + (Derivative(Phi0(r), r) + (l + 1)/r)*K(r) + Derivative(K(r), r) - H0(r)/r

BU/W'.label: BU: equation for W'
BU/W'.ref: Burgio et al., arXiv:1106.2736 appendix A

BU/X'.label: BU: equation for X'
BU/X'.ref: Burgio et al., arXiv:1106.2736 appendix A
BU/X'.text: l*X(r)/r - ((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*(-2*l*(l + 1)*calV(r)*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)/r**2 + (l*(l + 1)/(2*r) + omega**2*r*exp(-2*Phi0(r)))*H1(r) + (3*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) - 1/r)*K(r) + Derivative(Phi0(r), r) - 2*(4*pi*G*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*exp(lambda0(r)) + omega**2*exp(-2*Phi0(r) + lambda0(r)) - r**2*(-2*exp(-lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)*Derivative(lambda0(r), r)/r**2 + 2*exp(-lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), (r, 2))/r**2 - 4*exp(-lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)/r**3)/2)*W(r)/r + 1/r)*exp(Phi0(r))/2 + Derivative(X(r), r)

BU/H0.label: BU: equation for H0
BU/H0.ref: Burgio et al., arXiv:1106.2736 appendix A
BU/H0.text: -8*pi*G*r**3*X(r)*exp(-Phi0(r)) + (l*(l + 1)*(4*pi*G*r**3*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + r*(1 - exp(-2*lambda0(r)))/2)/2 - omega**2*r**3*exp(-2*Phi0(r) - 2*lambda0(r)))*H1(r) - (-omega**2*r**3*exp(-2*Phi0(r)) + r*(l - 1)*(l + 2)/2 + (4*pi*G*r**3*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + r*(1 - exp(-2*lambda0(r)))/2)*(4*pi*G*r**3*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 3*r*(1 - exp(-2*lambda0(r)))/2 - r)*exp(2*lambda0(r))/r)*K(r) + (4*pi*G*r**3*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 3*r*(1 - exp(-2*lambda0(r)))/2 + r*(l - 1)*(l + 2)/2)*H0(r)

BU/V.label: BU: equation for V
BU/V.ref: Burgio et al., arXiv:1106.2736 appendix A
BU/V.text: -omega**2*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*calV(r)*exp(-Phi0(r)) - ((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*H0(r)*exp(Phi0(r))/2 + X(r) + r**(Phi0(r) - lambda0(r))*W(r)*n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), (n0(r), 2))*Derivative(n0(r), r)/r

KU/H1'.label: KU: equation for H1'
KU/H1'.text: r*Derivative(H1(r), r) - (-16*pi*G*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*calV(r) + H0(r) + K(r))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + (4*pi*G*r**2*(-(-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) - 2*epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + l + (1 - exp(-2*lambda0(r)))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + 1)*H1(r)

KU/K'.label: KU: equation for K'
KU/K'.text: 8*pi*G*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*W(r)*exp(lambda0(r)) + r*Derivative(K(r), r) - ((l - 1)*(l + 2)/2 + 1)*H1(r) - (-l + (4*pi*G*r**2*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 1/2 - exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2)*exp(2*lambda0(r)) - 1)*K(r) - H0(r)

KU/X'.label: KU: equation for X'
KU/X'.text: l*X(r) + r*Derivative(X(r), r) - ((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*((-(4*pi*G*r**2*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 1/2 - exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2)*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + 1)*H0(r) + (3*(4*pi*G*r**2*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 1/2 - exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2)*exp(2*lambda0(r)) - 1)*K(r) + (omega**2*r**2*exp(-2*Phi0(r)) + (l - 1)*(l + 2)/2 + 1)*H1(r) - (8*pi*G*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*exp(lambda0(r)) + 2*omega**2*exp(-2*Phi0(r))*exp(lambda0(r)) - 2*r**2*((4*pi*G*r**2*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 1/2 - exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2)*exp(lambda0(r))*Derivative(lambda0(r), r)/r**3 + (4*pi*G*r**2*n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), (n0(r), 2))*Derivative(n0(r), r) + 8*pi*G*r*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(lambda0(r), r))*exp(lambda0(r))/r**3 - 3*(4*pi*G*r**2*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 1/2 - exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2)*exp(lambda0(r))/r**4))*W(r) - (2*(l - 1)*(l + 2) + 4)*(4*pi*G*r**2*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 1/2 - exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2)*calV(r)*exp(2*lambda0(r))/r**2)*exp(Phi0(r))/2

KU/H0.label: KU: equation for H0
KU/H0.text: -8*pi*G*r**2*X(r)*exp(-Phi0(r)) + (-omega**2*r**2*exp(-2*Phi0(r) - 2*lambda0(r)) + ((l - 1)*(l + 2)/2 + 1)*(4*pi*G*r**2*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 1/2 - exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2))*H1(r) - (-omega**2*r**2*exp(-2*Phi0(r)) + (l - 1)*(l + 2)/2 - ((4*pi*G*r**2*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 1/2 - exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2)*exp(2*lambda0(r)) - 1)*(4*pi*G*r**2*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 1/2 - exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2))*K(r) + (4*pi*G*r**2*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + (l - 1)*(l + 2)/2 + 3/2 - 3*exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2)*H0(r)

KU/V.label: KU: equation for V
KU/V.text: calV(r) - (-H0(r)*exp(Phi0(r))/2 + X(r)/((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) - (4*pi*G*r**2*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 1/2 - exp(-2*lambda0(r))/2)*W(r)*exp(Phi0(r) + lambda0(r))/r**2)*exp(Phi0(r))/omega**2

ZH/H1'.label: ZH: equation for H1'
ZH/H1'.ref: Zhang et al., arXiv:2601.21911 appendix A
ZH/H1'.text: Derivative(H1(r), r) - (-16*pi*G*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*calV(r) + H0(r) + K(r))*exp(2*lambda0(r))/r - (-4*pi*G*r**2*(-(-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) - 2*epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) - l - (1 - exp(-2*lambda0(r)))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) - 1)*H1(r)/r

ZH/K'.label: ZH: equation for K'
ZH/K'.ref: Zhang et al., arXiv:2601.21911 appendix A
ZH/K'.text: 8*pi*G*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*W(r)*exp(lambda0(r))/r - l*(l + 1)*H1(r)/(2*r) + (-Derivative(Phi0(r), r) + (l + 1)/r)*K(r) + Derivative(K(r), r) - H0(r)/r

ZH/W'.label: ZH: equation for W'
ZH/W'.ref: Zhang et al., arXiv:2601.21911 appendix A

ZH/X'.label: ZH: equation for X'
ZH/X'.ref: Zhang et al., arXiv:2601.21911 appendix A
ZH/X'.text: l*X(r)/r - ((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*(-2*l*(l + 1)*calV(r)*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)/r**2 + (l*(l + 1)/(2*r) + omega**2*r*exp(-2*Phi0(r)))*H1(r) + (-Derivative(Phi0(r), r) + 1/r)*H0(r) + (3*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) - 1/r)*K(r) - 2*(4*pi*G*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*exp(lambda0(r)) + omega**2*exp(-2*Phi0(r) + lambda0(r)) - r**2*(-2*exp(-lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)*Derivative(lambda0(r), r)/r**2 + 2*exp(-lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), (r, 2))/r**2 - 4*exp(-lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)/r**3)/2)*W(r)/r)*exp(Phi0(r))/2 + Derivative(X(r), r)

ZH/H0.label: ZH: equation for H0
ZH/H0.ref: Zhang et al., arXiv:2601.21911 appendix A
ZH/H0.text: -8*pi*G*r**3*X(r)*exp(-Phi0(r)) + (l*(l + 1)*(4*pi*G*r**3*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + r*(1 - exp(-2*lambda0(r)))/2)/2 - omega**2*r**3*exp(-2*Phi0(r) - 2*lambda0(r)))*H1(r) - (-omega**2*r**3*exp(-2*Phi0(r)) + r*(l - 1)*(l + 2)/2 - (4*pi*G*r**3*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + r*(1 - exp(-2*lambda0(r)))/2)*(4*pi*G*r**3*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 3*r*(1 - exp(-2*lambda0(r)))/2 - r)*exp(2*lambda0(r))/r)*K(r) + (4*pi*G*r**3*(-epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) + 3*r*(1 - exp(-2*lambda0(r)))/2 + r*(l - 1)*(l + 2)/2)*H0(r)

ZH/V.label: ZH: equation for V
ZH/V.ref: Zhang et al., arXiv:2601.21911 appendix A
ZH/V.text: -omega**3*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*calV(r)*exp(-Phi0(r)) - ((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*H0(r)*exp(Phi0(r))/2 + X(r) + W(r)*n0(r)*exp(Phi0(r) - lambda0(r))*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), (n0(r), 2))*Derivative(n0(r), r)/r

METFIX/H1'.label: METFIX: equation for H1'
METFIX/H1'.ref: ZL with Q from the metric, sign of 2 w^2 W corrected (base of the extended system)
METFIX/H1'.text: r*Derivative(H1(r), r) - (-16*pi*G*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*calV(r) + H0(r) + K(r))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + (4*pi*G*r**2*(-(-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) - 2*epsilon0(n0(r)) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + l + (1 - exp(-2*lambda0(r)))*exp(2*lambda0(r)) + 1)*H1(r)

METFIX/K'.label: METFIX: equation for K'
METFIX/K'.ref: ZL with Q from the metric, sign of 2 w^2 W corrected (base of the extended system)
METFIX/K'.text: 8*pi*G*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*W(r)*exp(lambda0(r)) + r*Derivative(K(r), r) - ((l - 1)*(l + 2)/2 + 1)*H1(r) - (-l + r*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) - 1)*K(r) - H0(r)

METFIX/W'.label: METFIX: equation for W'
METFIX/W'.ref: ZL with Q from the metric, sign of 2 w^2 W corrected (base of the extended system)

METFIX/X'.label: METFIX: equation for X'
METFIX/X'.ref: ZL with Q from the metric, sign of 2 w^2 W corrected (base of the extended system)
METFIX/X'.text: l*X(r) + r*Derivative(X(r), r) - ((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*((-r*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) + 1)*H0(r) + (3*r*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) - 1)*K(r) + (omega**2*r**2*exp(-2*Phi0(r)) + (l - 1)*(l + 2)/2 + 1)*H1(r) + (-8*pi*G*((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r)))*exp(lambda0(r)) - 2*omega**2*exp(-2*Phi0(r) + lambda0(r)) + r**2*(-2*exp(-lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)*Derivative(lambda0(r), r)/r**2 + 2*exp(-lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), (r, 2))/r**2 - 4*exp(-lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)/r**3))*W(r) - (2*(l - 1)*(l + 2) + 4)*calV(r)*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)/r)*exp(Phi0(r))/2

METFIX/H0.label: METFIX: equation for H0
METFIX/H0.ref: ZL with Q from the metric, sign of 2 w^2 W corrected (base of the extended system)
METFIX/H0.text: -8*pi*G*r**2*X(r)*exp(-Phi0(r)) + (-omega**2*r**2*exp(-2*Phi0(r) - 2*lambda0(r)) + r*((l - 1)*(l + 2)/2 + 1)*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r))*H1(r) - (-omega**2*r**2*exp(-2*Phi0(r)) - r*(r*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) - 1)*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) + (l - 1)*(l + 2)/2)*K(r) + (r*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r) + (l - 1)*(l + 2)/2 + 1 - exp(-2*lambda0(r)))*H0(r)

METFIX/V.label: METFIX: equation for V
METFIX/V.ref: ZL with Q from the metric, sign of 2 w^2 W corrected (base of the extended system)
METFIX/V.text: calV(r) - (-H0(r)*exp(Phi0(r))/2 + X(r)/((-m_N + mstar(a0(r)))*n0(r) + n0(r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n0(r)), n0(r))) - W(r)*exp(Phi0(r) + lambda0(r))*exp(-2*lambda0(r))*Derivative(Phi0(r), r)/r)*exp(Phi0(r))/omega**2

ZL_FIX/X'.ref: Zhao & Lattimer with the sign erratum corrected
